reviews.comment: Always checks canvas activity. Paranoid about cheating. Doesn't ask questions straight reporter. Insist on you meeting with her after every quiz quite odd. I know someone she reported didn't even ask questions or talk to them. There is a reason so many people Q dropped her the only time she has taught this course.

reviews.comment: She literally just reads off of slides, graded off of 6 quizzes and 10% attendance with lowest quiz dropped. Quizzes are nothing like the iclicker in class + questions are very ambiguous, more than 1 answer could be correct. Class averages were low. Many people including myself had to Q-drop. She makes the class way harder than it needs to be.
